nodes.name: DemoTickEngine.java
nodes.summary: Simulates live FX quotes for every warehouse currency pair by walking bid/ask from last 1s bars or DemoMarket seeds, then exposing stepped ticks and snapshots for ingest.
nodes.languageNotes: Inner SimulatedQuote holds per-pair Gaussian random-walk state and maps to FxQuoteMessage.

nodes.name: DemoTickEngine
nodes.summary: Spring component that loads currency pairs, seeds simulated quotes from cache or DemoMarket, and advances all quotes each tick.

nodes.name: loadFromWarehouse
nodes.summary: Clears in-memory quotes and rebuilds SimulatedQuote entries from CurrencyPairService.list and the latest 1s bar.

nodes.name: stepAll
nodes.summary: Advances every simulated quote one random-walk step and returns the resulting FxQuoteMessage list.

nodes.name: snapshot
nodes.summary: Returns current bid/ask/mid messages for all loaded pairs without advancing the walk.

nodes.name: lastOneSecondBar
nodes.summary: Queries the 1s cache namespace for the newest bar of a pair so SimulatedQuote can seed from bid close.

nodes.name: QuoteBus.java
nodes.summary: Publishes live FX quotes and forming OHLC bars to Redis as JSON, writing last-value keys and broadcasting on dedicated channels.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses StringRedisTemplate convertAndSend plus Jackson ObjectMapper for pub/sub payloads.

nodes.name: QuoteBus
nodes.summary: Redis-backed bus that stores and publishes FxQuoteMessage and FormingBarMessage payloads for chart clients.

nodes.name: publish
nodes.summary: Writes the latest quote JSON under a pair key and publishes it on the quote channel.

nodes.name: publishForming
nodes.summary: Maps a cached bar plus namespace into FormingBarMessage, stores it by resolution/symbol, and publishes on the bar channel.

nodes.name: key
nodes.summary: Builds the Redis last-quote key from a numeric currency-pair code.

nodes.name: formingKey
nodes.summary: Builds the Redis forming-bar key from TradingView resolution and pair name.

nodes.name: TickIngestWorker.java
nodes.summary: Startup and scheduled worker that drives DemoTickEngine, upserts open bars across cache namespaces, and publishes quotes and forming bars on QuoteBus.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements ApplicationRunner for seed-time snapshots and a scheduled tick after cache seed completes.

nodes.name: TickIngestWorker
nodes.summary: Orchestrates demo tick ingest: snapshot on boot, then periodically step quotes and roll forming OHLC bars into store, repository, and Redis.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: ApplicationRunner hook that loads warehouse quotes and publishes initial quote and forming-bar snapshots.

nodes.name: tick
nodes.summary: Scheduled cycle that waits for cache seed, steps all demo quotes, upserts open bars, and publishes each quote.

nodes.name: publishFormingSnapshotForPair
nodes.summary: Loads the latest cached bar per CacheNamespace for one pair and republishes it as a forming bar.

nodes.name: upsertOpenBars
nodes.summary: Resolves the quote's pair and upserts the current open bar for every cache namespace.

nodes.name: upsertOpenBar
nodes.summary: Opens a new bar or applies the tick to the existing forming bar, then persists to repository and cache and publishes forming state.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing the active FX currency-pair catalog used by chart symbol pickers.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairController
nodes.summary: Authenticated GET handler that returns the priority-ordered currency pair list from CurrencyPairService.

nodes.name: curpairs
nodes.summary: GET /api/1.0/curpairs endpoint returning the full CurrencyPairDto list.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairDto.java
nodes.summary: API and cache-facing DTO carrying numeric pair code, display name, and sort priority for FX symbols.
nodes.languageNotes: Java record used as the shared currency-pair transfer object.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairDto
nodes.summary: Immutable currency-pair record with curpairCd, curpairName, curpairDisplay, and priority.

nodes.name: FormingBarMessage.java
nodes.summary: Redis/WebSocket payload for the in-progress OHLC bar of a symbol at a given TradingView resolution.
nodes.languageNotes: Java record describing bid/ask OHLC plus volume for a forming bar.

nodes.name: FormingBarMessage
nodes.summary: Immutable forming-bar message with pair identity, resolution, period, timestamp, and bid/ask OHLC fields.

nodes.name: FxQuoteMessage.java
nodes.summary: Live tick payload with bid, ask, mid, and session high/low used by QuoteBus and the demo tick engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Java record for Redis-published FX quotes.

nodes.name: FxQuoteMessage
nodes.summary: Immutable quote record keyed by curpairCd with timestamped bid/ask/mid and high/low.

nodes.name: Ccypair.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity for warehouse currency pairs, including Japanese name, rate unit, delete flag, and display priority.
nodes.languageNotes: JPA entity mapped to the CCYPAIR table with ACTIVE flag constant.

nodes.name: Ccypair
nodes.summary: Persistent currency-pair row with code, JP label, rate unit, soft-delete flag, and priority used for catalog ordering.

nodes.name: CcypairRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for active currency pairs: lookup by code, priority-ordered lists, and name search.

nodes.name: CcypairRepository
nodes.summary: JpaRepository interface querying Ccypair by delete flag, priority, and optional search text.
nodes.languageNotes: Spring Data JPA derived queries plus a custom searchActive method.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairService.java
nodes.summary: Service contract for listing active FX pairs and resolving one pair by numeric code.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairService
nodes.summary: Interface exposing list() of CurrencyPairDto and find(curpairCd) for tick ingest and catalog consumers.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Loads active Ccypair rows, maps them to CurrencyPairDto, and formats six-letter codes as XXX/YYY display names.

nodes.name: CurrencyPairServiceImpl
nodes.summary: CurrencyPairService implementation backed by CcypairRepository with priority-ordered list and code lookup.

nodes.name: list
nodes.summary: Returns all active pairs ordered by priority, mapped to CurrencyPairDto.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Finds an active pair by numeric code (priority) or returns empty when missing.

nodes.name: SymbolCatalogImpl.java
nodes.summary: Builds the TradingView symbol catalog from currency pairs and AppProperties exchange/type, then resolves symbols by ticker aliases.

nodes.name: SymbolCatalogImpl
nodes.summary: In-memory SymbolCatalog that maps each CurrencyPairDto to CachedSymbol with DemoMarket price scale.

nodes.name: SymbolCatalogImpl
nodes.summary: Constructor that reads TradingView exchange/type from AppProperties and materializes CachedSymbol rows from pair list.

nodes.name: getAll
nodes.summary: Returns the full cached symbol list for datafeed search and config.

nodes.name: find
nodes.summary: Resolves a symbol name against ticker, full name, short name, provider symbol, pair code, or fx: prefix.

nodes.name: fromPair
nodes.summary: Maps a CurrencyPairDto plus exchange/type into a CachedSymbol including DemoMarket price scale.

nodes.name: DemoMarket.java
nodes.summary: Static FX demo-market helpers for price scale, seed bid/mid, bar amplitude, spreads, and wicks, with JPY-quote vs majors branching.
nodes.languageNotes: Non-instantiable utility class with a private constructor and yenQuote branching.

nodes.name: DemoMarket
nodes.summary: Shared demo pricing constants and formulas used by tick simulation, mock bars, and symbol priceScale.

nodes.name: priceScale
nodes.summary: Returns TradingView priceScale (100 vs 100000) depending on whether the quote currency is JPY.

nodes.name: seedBid
nodes.summary: Computes a starting bid as seed mid minus half spread for demo ticks.

nodes.name: seedMid
nodes.summary: Returns a hardcoded mid seed for well-known pairs, otherwise a yen-aware default.

nodes.name: barAmplitude
nodes.summary: Typical mock-bar body amplitude, larger for JPY-quoted pairs.

nodes.name: halfSpread
nodes.summary: Half bid/ask spread used to derive seed bid and full spread.

nodes.name: fullSpread
nodes.summary: Full bid/ask spread as twice halfSpread for SimulatedQuote ask derivation.

nodes.name: outerWick
nodes.summary: Wick size for generated demo bars, scaled for JPY quotes.
